best_match.fbbt_definition: Transcriptional clusters corresponding to this cell type were identified in single-cell RNA-seq data from pupal stages (Xie et al., 2021). At 24h APF, the corresponding transcriptional cluster was identified using intersections between projection neuron drivers and GAL4 lines for differentially expressed genes, and clusters at other stages were matched to it based on shared differentially expressed genes and marker expression (Xie et al., 2021). Immature secondary neuron that is a precursor to an adult antennal lobe projection neuron DM6 adPN (Yu et al., 2010; Xie et al., 2021).

justification: DM6 adPNs. Up to the pupal stage the immature or pupal term is used (curator); FBbt #2220, release 2026-11-02. Lineage: the authors' per-cell `lineage` for this type in the main analysis: adPN 75, unlabelled 4. kn+ PNs (knot analysis, no lineage column): the paper states they "include six types of adPNs and two vPNs" (Figure 2), i.e. D, DM6, VA1v, VM2, VM7, VM5v (adPN) and the two vPNs.
